name: Mace Windu's lightsaber
description: Mace Windu's lightsaber was the weapon wielded by the Jedi Master during his career. It was unique among Jedi as it produced an amethyst blade when activated, rather than the more common green or blue. Windu wielded his lightsaber in many skirmishes and battles across the galaxy during notable events such as the Clone Wars. That conflict saw the blade used on battlefronts such as Ryloth, Dantooine, Boz Pity, Coruscant, and others.
